## Story DD Coverage
(Infrastructure task — adds the per-agent schema-preservation sub-section that the approach-proposer agent stub references. DD ownership is implicit via the UPDATE agent task that depends on this sub-section existing.)

## Description

Add a named sub-section to plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md titled exactly `### Schema Preservation — approach-proposer`. 

PATH NOTE: The selected approach lists `plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md`, but the dependency authoring task (6f29-3fc8-e0eb-4079) may use `plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md`. The agent executing this task MUST resolve the actual location:
```
ls plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md 2>/dev/null
```
Edit whichever file exists. If neither exists, the dependency task (6f29) has not yet landed — this task is blocked.

The sub-section MUST specify, for delta-mode approach-proposer output:
1. Which top-level keys are preserved verbatim when not named in any finding (proposals, distinctness_summary, complexity_gate_summary, generation_notes).
2. Preserve-by-omission rule: proposals not named in any finding MUST appear unchanged in delta output; partial-update is only valid for proposals explicitly named.
3. Distinctness-gate preservation: the four-axis distinctness invariant must still hold across delta output (modified + preserved proposals).
4. Complexity-gate preservation: each preserved proposal's prior gate outcomes are carried forward verbatim; only proposals being modified re-run the gates.

Do NOT edit any other section of the protocol doc.

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria

- Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- Protocol doc exists at one of the two candidate paths — Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md || test -f plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md
- Sub-section header exists — Verify: PROTO=$(ls plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md 2>/dev/null | head -1) && grep -qF '### Schema Preservation — approach-proposer' "$PROTO"
- Sub-section enumerates the four preserved top-level keys — Verify: PROTO=$(ls plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md 2>/dev/null | head -1) && awk '/^### Schema Preservation — approach-proposer/,/^### /' "$PROTO" | grep -qE 'proposals' && awk '/^### Schema Preservation — approach-proposer/,/^### /' "$PROTO" | grep -qE 'distinctness_summary'
- Sub-section states the preserve-by-omission rule — Verify: PROTO=$(ls plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md 2>/dev/null | head -1) && awk '/^### Schema Preservation — approach-proposer/,/^### /' "$PROTO" | grep -qEi 'preserve|not named in any finding|omit unchanged'
- Sub-section preserves the four-axis distinctness invariant — Verify: PROTO=$(ls plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md 2>/dev/null | head -1) && awk '/^### Schema Preservation — approach-proposer/,/^### /' "$PROTO" | grep -qEi 'four-axis|distinctness'
